texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Why Sesame?: Voice is the first interface that makes AI feel like a companion rather than a tool, and shipping it well means hardware, latency and product judgment meeting in one place - that intersection is where I want to work. My current proof of craft: a production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines) that I run in public - persistent memory over a 10-year knowledge base, agent consensus, 100+ automation routines - essentially building an always-on AI partner and living with the result every day. Add 10+ years as a venture founder owning problem framing, architecture decisions, evaluation and GTM, and Sesame's hardware PM seat is the natural next step: operator discipline, daily-driver empathy for AI companions, end-to-end ownership.
texts.What's the consumer hardware: Honest answer: I have not shipped a consumer hardware product - my record is software and systems. The closest analogues: (1) the physical 6-machine agent fleet I specified, assembled and operate 24/7 - procurement, thermals, failure modes and uptime are my daily reality, at fleet-of-one scale; (2) crypto-exchange infrastructure (matching engines, market-maker and high-frequency trading systems) where reliability constraints feel closer to hardware than to typical web software; (3) a self-built CRM used daily by up to 30 operators - my [человек] lesson in product empathy under real load. I bring senior product judgment and AI-native depth, would lean on Sesame's hardware veterans for the manufacturing half, and own the product end to end.
